answer_1.quote: Our experiments on mathematical reasoning and question‑answering tasks highlight the superior performance of NAT... We evaluate different models and training strategies on four test datasets: GSM8K, ASDiv, SVAMP, MultiArith, HotpotQA, StrategyQA.
